name: FileBrowser
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/FileBrowser
summary: The file browser a storage resource opens on: one flush `CardBox` holding a borderless `Table` whose toolbar is the whole page header. The toolbar stacks the storage name beside the storage glyph, a large row of the table’s own search plus the refresh, download and columns IconButtons, then a `Breadcrumb` of the folder path beside the Add to files `SplitButton` (Upload file, Add folder). Folders sort first with a link-coloured folder glyph and open on click, a .. row leads back up once inside a folder, files take a glyph by extension, Size is muted and Last Modified pairs the editor `Avatar` (named in a `Tooltip`) with the relative time; folders carry Open and files Download in their row menu, with Delete below. Storage with nothing at its root renders the table’s empty slot: an `EmptyState` (This folder is empty) with a secondary Add to files split button; inside a folder the .. row always remains. Built from `CardBox`, `Table` with `Table.Search`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `Popover`, `Switch`, `Breadcrumb`, `SplitButton`, `Avatar`, `Dropdown` and `EmptyState`.

variants.summary: Inside a build folder: the crumb gains the folder, a .. row leads back up, and the files carry their glyph, size, editor and age.
